name: resume-editor
description: Create, validate, and optimize importable drafts for the Resume Editor HTML tool.

interface.shortDescription: Turn JD feedback into importable resume drafts.
interface.longDescription: Resume Editor helps ChatGPT and Codex work with the editable HTML resume tool. It exposes schema, validation, JD signal extraction, and import-payload packaging so users can optimize a resume in conversation and import the result back into the editor.
defaultPrompt: Optimize my resume draft for this JD.
Create a Resume Editor import JSON.
Check whether my resume draft is one-page safe.
